The {{TAG|EIGENVAL}} file contains the Kohn-Sham-eigenvalues for all k-points, at the end of the simulation. For dynamic simulations ({{TAG|IBRION}}=0) the eigenvalues on the file are usually the ones predicted for the next step: i.e. the file  is compatible with the {{TAG|CONTCAR}} file. For static calculations and relaxations ({{TAG|IBRION}}=-1|1|2) the eigenvalues are the solution of the KS-equations for the last step.

Mind: For dynamic simulations ({{TAG|IBRION}}=0) the {{TAG|EIGENVAL}} file contains predicted wavefunctions compatible with the {{TAG|CONTCAR}} file. If you want to use the eigenvalues  for additional calculations, first copy the {{TAG|CONTCAR}} file to the {{TAG|POSCAR}} file and make another static ({{TAG|ISTART}}=1, {{TAG|NSW}}=0) continuation run with {{TAG|ICHARG}}=1.
